name: Ting Hao A
reviews: Great korean-chinese food! On weekdays you can order “mini” portions of some of the main dishes which is great for sharing. We had the jjajang noodles which was delicious and we loved the tang su yook and yuzu yu rin ki too (spicy). Highly recommend!! 💯

Considering that I am not a huge fan of Jjajangmyeon, their Wagyu Jjajangmyeon was delicious as the sauce was not too sweet, grilled flamey beef was tender and juicy.  The best one was white Jjamgppong. It was delicious!!!! We had also Cream Prawn which was too thick in rough batter, the sweet and sour pork was good. Serving staff were all attentive amd friendly.

After looking forward to visiting for a long time
Had a nice lunch set combination
but surprised by way too tiny portions
Tastes of food was nothing worth for 2 hours of driving and parking near by
Also took us nearly 1 hour just getting out of carpark was the worst parking experience in my life.
Cute quokka logo, though
the food was very delicious and great value. The staff were really friendly and the service was quick! Would recommend going again!

A Chinese restaurant inspired by Korean techniques and flavours, situated in the centre of Chatswood, Ting Hao A gives twist to the standard Chinese dishes. I recommend the fried chicken, very tender, crispy and has nice Yuzu sauce. The sweet and sour pork was a bit disappointing, as the meat was too lean and batter didn't work well with the sauce. Staff were always smiling and food came quickly. A good spot for a casual catch up. Worth a try!
